headline: Ethereum Pushes Major Network Upgrade to 2027 Over Smart Contract Bug Concerns
summary: Ethereum developers delayed the Glamsterdam network upgrade from December until at least January 2027 to allow applications time to fix affected smart contracts.
why: Upgrade delays on the Ethereum network affect planned technical improvements and decentralized application infrastructure across the broader digital asset ecosystem.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: Core developers delayed the Glamsterdam upgrade into 2027 to prevent breaking live smart contracts.
